open_points.subject: flow:run_effect_with_approval — approving an effect after its request changes
open_points.text: “The request is sent at once, in the owner's request” contradicts A10 rule 1: “any difference ... means the approval is no authority for this send ... otherwise requests a new approval.”
open_points.question: If the rebuilt request_digest differs after the owner approves, does the approval request send the effect or leave it waiting for a new approval?
options: Do not send; create a new approval request for the rebuilt request
Send the rebuilt request immediately under the approved decision
open_points.default_guess: Do not send; create a new approval request for the rebuilt request.
